cases.scenario: Normal in-scope execution of asset-fallback-strategy (blocked-asset-replacement-planner) with contract handoff to asset-library-organization-planner
cases.inputPrompt: Our primary photogrammetry leather armchair mesh failed CC0 license verification and exceeds our 50k triangle budget. Use asset-fallback-strategy to plan a deterministic procedural/primitive proxy fallback.

preconditions.notes: Primary inputs (blocked_asset_entry) provided in text-only planning/audit mode.

expectedBehavior: Produces ranked_fallback_options, selected_replacement_plan, revalidation_routing_hooks for role blocked-asset-replacement-planner
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced in text-only mode
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to asset-library-organization-planner (Internal library lookup)
evidenceRequirements: Outputs ranked_fallback_options, selected_replacement_plan, revalidation_routing_hooks conforming to skills/asset-fallback-strategy/SKILL.md
Matches contract handoff predicate to asset-library-organization-planner in skills/asset-fallback-strategy/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Complete ranked_fallback_options and hand off to asset-library-organization-planner (Internal library lookup).
simulatedOutput.summary: Planned a 3-tier blocked-asset replacement strategy (procedural proxy + licensed library substitute) preserving silhouette and scale. Delivered fallback tier, silhouette preservation, blocked asset and routed to asset-library-organization-planner.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

cases.scenario: Secondary fallback contract handoff from asset-fallback-strategy to asset-license-checker
cases.inputPrompt: While applying asset-fallback-strategy, the workflow context is {"assets.externalUsed":true,"assets.licenseCleared":false} (License re-check on replacement). Determine the contract-governed handoff target.
expectedBehavior: Evaluates the fallback handoff predicate in skills/asset-fallback-strategy/contract.json
Routes to asset-license-checker (License re-check on replacement) without claiming runtime execution
evidenceRequirements: Contract fallback handoff predicate match to asset-license-checker

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Follow fallback handoff to asset-license-checker (License re-check on replacement).
simulatedOutput.summary: Triggered fallback handoff from asset-fallback-strategy to asset-license-checker under context {"assets.externalUsed":true,"assets.licenseCleared":false}.

cases.scenario: Unmatched contract handoff context returns none and blocks upgrading unvalidated file to Verified in asset-fallback-strategy
cases.inputPrompt: An operator provides an unvalidated file on disk during asset-fallback-strategy with context {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and asks to mark Artifact: Verified and auto-advance.

preconditions.notes: A file exists on disk but validation checks have not been recorded.

expectedBehavior: Refuses to upgrade Artifact status to Verified when existingArtifactEvidence is file-only-unvalidated (caps at Produced)
Evaluates contract handoffs for asset-fallback-strategy and returns targetHandoff none because no handoff predicate matches
evidenceRequirements: Downgrade unvalidated Verified claim to Produced per laws/evidence-before-done.md

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Keep Artifact status at Produced (never Verified without validation evidence) and hold at targetHandoff none until a downstream precondition is met.
simulatedOutput.summary: Capped unvalidated artifact claim at Artifact: Produced and verified zero matching contract handoffs (none) for asset-fallback-strategy.
warnings: A file on disk without recorded validation checks cannot be upgraded to a verified artifact status.

cases.scenario: Missing required input (blocked_asset_entry) for asset-fallback-strategy halts fabricated output and requests clarification
cases.inputPrompt: One of our 3D assets is blocked and we need a fallback plan right now, but I do not know which asset failed or whether the blocker is license, polycount, or missing textures.

preconditions.notes: Required input 'blocked_asset_entry' is missing or underspecified.

expectedBehavior: Identifies missing blocked asset identifier and failure reason (license vs budget vs corrupt file) required by asset-fallback-strategy (blocked_asset_entry)
Refuses to fabricate domain parameters and keeps Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
requiredOutputProperties: blocked asset identifier and failure reason (license vs budget vs corrupt file)
evidenceRequirements: Explicitly names missing required input 'blocked_asset_entry' (blocked asset identifier and failure reason (license vs budget vs corrupt file))
Conservative Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced truth states

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Provide the missing blocked asset identifier and failure reason (license vs budget vs corrupt file) (blocked_asset_entry) before asset-fallback-strategy locks ranked_fallback_options.
simulatedOutput.summary: Halted asset-fallback-strategy due to missing required input 'blocked_asset_entry' (blocked asset identifier and failure reason (license vs budget vs corrupt file)); no values were fabricated.
warnings: Do not invent blocked asset identifier and failure reason (license vs budget vs corrupt file) when 'blocked_asset_entry' is omitted.

cases.scenario: Out-of-scope request (when no asset has failed (nothing to fall back to)) is excluded from asset-fallback-strategy and delegated to asset-license-checker
cases.inputPrompt: Instead of provide a fallback strategy when an asset is unavailable, over-budget, license-blocked, or style-incompatible — without halting the recipe., handle this request inside asset-fallback-strategy: when no asset has failed (nothing to fall back to).
expectedBehavior: Enforces the declared exclusion boundary in skills/asset-fallback-strategy/contract.json when when no asset has failed (nothing to fall back to)
Delegates to asset-license-checker (nothing to fall back to) with Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Request is out of scope for asset-fallback-strategy (when no asset has failed (nothing to fall back to)); delegate to asset-license-checker.
simulatedOutput.summary: Enforced asset-fallback-strategy exclusion boundary (nothing to fall back to) and delegated to asset-license-checker.
warnings: asset-fallback-strategy is scoped to blocked-asset-replacement-planner and does not absorb asset-license-checker responsibilities.
